name: samona
description: SAMONA monorepo — on-demand marketplace for local skilled professionals.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.clean: rimraf "packages/*/dist" "packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo" server/dist server/*.tsbuildinfo apps/pro/.expo apps/pro/dist apps/customer/.expo apps/customer/dist
scripts.build:apk:pro: npm run build:packages && eas build --local --platform android --profile preview --cwd apps/pro
scripts.build:apk:customer: npm run build:packages && eas build --local --platform android --profile preview --cwd apps/customer
